skeleton: /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Meshes/SK_Mannequin (89 bones, names/hierarchy/rest pose unchanged from Characters/Dink/HandBindingV2)

MI_Milder_PR_Skin.shading: subsurface profile / skin; SSS.rgb = scatter colour x thickness
MI_Milder_PR_Skin.normal: OpenGL (+Y), flip green for UE as the existing importer does

MI_Milder_PR_Eyes.shading: default lit, low roughness from ORM.G; single-shell eye with modelled cornea bulge

MI_Milder_PR_Hair.shading: hair shading model, MASKED (alpha in BC.a, clip about 0.33 with dithered opacity / TAA), two-sided; cap shell + lock cards + brow and lash cards in one slot
MI_Milder_PR_Hair.anisotropy: FLOW.rg = strand direction in UV space, encoded 0.5 + 0.5 * d (root to tip): world tangent = normalize(d.x * dP/du + d.y * dP/dv); use it as the hair tangent / anisotropy direction so highlights run along the hair. Baked from the strand groom (cap rect) and from the strand clumps (card tiles). N is the strand-relief normal (OpenGL), ORM.r = strand depth occlusion, ORM.g = roughness.
MI_Milder_PR_Hair.masks: FLOW.b = back-light mask (0 on the opaque cap shell, 1 on cards: scale back-scatter / two-sided transmission by it). MSK.r = strand depth, MSK.g = per-strand id (use for per-strand colour / roughness jitter), MSK.b = root-to-tip gradient (0 root, 1 tip; the BC already carries a root-dark to tip-light gradient).
MI_Milder_PR_Hair.atlas_layout: uv: cap texture u 0-0.5, v 0.5-1 (whole groom projected about the head centre, opaque under-fill inside the hairline); 32 narrow lock tiles u 0.5-1, v 0.25-1 (root at top); 4 wide tiles u 0-0.5, v 0.25-0.5; brow groom band u 0-0.5, v 0-0.25; lash band u 0.5-1, v 0-0.25
MI_Milder_PR_Hair.shell_order: vertex attribute hl (also the build order, inner first): 1 = cap shell (opaque, never drop, casts the shadow), 2 = mid lock cards, 3 = outer lock cards, 4 = brows and lashes, 5 = hairline wisps and flyaways. LOD1 keeps all, LOD2 drops 5, LOD3 keeps 1, 3, 4. Custom split normals are scalp-blended and exported in the FBX: import normals, do not recompute.

budget_note: LOD0 34.6k triangles: over the 20k soft target, just under the 35k hard cap. Head 8.6k (MakeHuman topology), hands thinned to about a third, bare arms and shoulders 2k, hair about 4k, armour and clothing about 17k.
known_weaknesses: Not photoreal at 1 m; reads as an armoured young man at gameplay distance. The last review round (r7) still faulted everything below.

Hair cards against the strand groom (Review/r7_hair_compare.png): colour and crop shape are close at 2 m in sun; faults: the top is a smooth helmet-like surface with less depth than the fluffy strand crop, dark spikes stand at the silhouette where the strands show a soft ginger halo, the faded sides and nape end in a crisper edge than the strand fade, and under overcast the cards are darker. Lashes are not from a strand groom.

Face: built on the shipped MakeHuman male head with a heavier brow and jaw and stubble shadow; no expression shapes, so no smug look; he reads as a relative of Dink. Brows are now a baked strand groom (fuller than before) but read heavy and dark under overcast. Skin relief and roughness breakup were raised; the cheeks still read smooth at 0.6 m.
Elbow cops are not built. The hands are the shipped hand skin painted as grey gloves, not modelled gauntlets.

Back view: the sleeveless tabard's armhole edges are ragged behind the pauldrons and show jagged slivers of shoulder skin; a rectangular bake artefact (striped patch about 8 cm wide) sits on the back of the mail skirt left of centre; a few brown tabard specks come through the lower edge of the blue cowl.

Plate: pauldron dome with two lames, vambraces, greaves and knee cops are parametric shells with rolled edges, dents and a tooled border in the bake, but no rivets, no articulation and single-sided (thickness lips only); the knee cop is rigid on calf/thigh and will separate from the leg in a deep knee bend. The knee strap was dropped for budget, so the cop has no visible attachment; pauldron lames show one arm strap with buckle only.
Straps and buckles: ring straps lie on the plates and each carries a small iron buckle, but the buckles are 3-sided tubes and the strap does not thread through them.

Mail skirt is a textured shell (authored ring tile baked to normal/roughness/metal), no ring silhouette or alpha at the hem; weights are authored pelvis/thigh and were only checked by eye in the walk pair and turn (r4_skirt), not numerically.
Bare arms are re-fitted MakeHuman base-mesh faces scaled up for bulk: plausible but not strongly muscular; no veins or elbow detail.
Boots are plain soft leather under the greaves (the sprite reads as steel to the toe).
Validator: whole-mesh UV_OVERLAP as for Dink; LOD0 over the soft triangle target. Not imported or seen in Unreal; Physics Asset not made; no actions embedded.
hair: Game hair rebuilt 12 Nov 2026 from the strand groom: (1) an opaque cap shell that carries the whole evaluated groom, projected about the head centre into the cap rect of a 4096 atlas (colour with root-dark to tip-light gradient, strand-relief normal, depth occlusion, flow map; dark under-fill inside the hairline so no scalp shows), (2) narrow lock cards (20-85 hairs per tile, 5-10 mm wide at the tip) laid along the same guide field in two lifted layers that never dip under the cap, (3) hairline wisps and a few flyaways, (4) brow cards baked from a short strand groom. Lashes are still the CC0 MakeHuman lash cards. Acceptance renders: Review/<tag>_hair_compare.png (top = strands, bottom = cards; 2 m sun, 0.5 m sun, 0.5 m overcast, back, crown).
